summary: Robert E. Welland, 68, of Jefferson, CO, died after his snowmobile overturned and pinned him near the summit of Cottonwood Pass; a group member who rode back found the machine resting on top of him, pulled it off, and bystanders attempted CPR, but he was pronounced dead at the scene.
location: near the summit of Cottonwood Pass
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office / Chaffee County SAR / Chaffee EMS
notes: Heart of the Rockies Radio (opened run 601). Date inferred: article dates the incident 'Tuesday, February 8th'; 2022-02-08 was a Tuesday (2011/2005 also Tuesdays, but the station's SAR archive coverage begins ~2018). Pass sits on the Chaffee/Gunnison county line; filed Chaffee per the CCSO/CCSAR response (Brabander 2016 Cottonwood Pass precedent, id 2291).
